label: Variant A — Primary residence, bought with us
subject: Happy Home Anniversary, [First Name]!
body:
Hey [First Name(s)],

Happy Home Anniversary! It's hard to believe it's already been [N] years since you closed on your home at [Property Address] — time flies.

For most people, a home is their largest financial asset. Because of that, we consistently monitor local market trends and track your home's equity over time. Attached is an updated report detailing your property's current market value range.

We would love to hop on a quick call to review how your investment has performed over the past year and see how that fits into your future goals. (Also, if there are any other properties you would like us to run updated valuations on, we would be happy to put reports together for you!)

Would mornings or afternoons work better for a brief chat this week?

Looking forward to catching up!

Orit & Scott

label: Variant C — Investment / secondary property
subject: Happy Anniversary on Your Investment Property!
body:
Hey [First Name(s)],

Happy Purchase Anniversary on [Property Address]! It's been [N] year(s) since you added this one to your portfolio, and we still think of every property — this one included — as an investment worth actively managing, not just owning.

As an investor, you know that keeping a close eye on asset performance and market equity is essential to optimizing your portfolio. We consistently track local market trends, rental appreciation, and equity shifts to make sure your investments are working as hard as possible for you. Attached is an updated valuation and market analysis report for [Property Address].

We’d love to hop on a quick call to review how the property has performed over the past year and discuss your future investment strategy (whether that’s a 1031 exchange, tapping into built equity for your next acquisition, or simply optimizing current yields).

Also, if you have other properties in your portfolio that you’d like updated valuations or market reviews on, just let us know—we’d be happy to put those together for you.

Would mornings or afternoons work better for a brief chat this week?

Looking forward to connecting!
Orit & Scott
